pages.text: An antiproton and a positron make $(item)antihydrogen$(), and its spectral lines sit exactly where hydrogen's do - measured to twelve decimal places, and still CPT holds.

The $(item)Antiproton Decelerator$() brakes antiprotons from collisions until they can be trapped, and combines them with positrons into $(fluid)Antihydrogen$(). $(fluid)Antiwater$() from the Antiverse sea can be split in the $(item)Electrolytic Cell$() for the same gas.
A few billion antiprotons, slowed from near light speed and held in a magnetic bottle.$(br2)Made in $(item)Antiproton Decelerator$().
Frozen antihydrogen: one antiproton, one positron, a few kelvin.$(br2)Made in $(item)Antiproton Decelerator$().

$(fluid)Antiwater$(). Made in $(item)Mirror Matter Foundry$().$(br)Used for: Antihydrogen, Empty Containment Cell.
